post_clip.description: A person on a scooter (wearing striped shirt) dismounts, approaches the rear of a parked silver car, and appears to interact with the open trunk or rear area while the driver is absent; shortly after, they return to their scooter and prepare to leave — consistent with covert theft of unattended items from a vehicle.

A second man (in blue patterned shirt) approaches the first man (in striped shirt) who is standing next to a parked scooter; the second man appears to quickly reach toward the first man's waist/pocket area and then immediately turns and walks away rapidly, while the first man reacts by turning and stepping back—consistent with a covert snatch theft (e.g., phone or wallet) from a distracted person, followed by fleeing.
